meta.title: KidsStore — pieces for real childhood
meta.description: A curated selection of children's clothing, toys and accessories. Real materials, built to last, without the exaggerated cuteness.

hero.headline: Pieces built for real childhood — and for staying around after it
hero.sub: We only carry what survives the twentieth wash, the next kid in the family, and one more season outdoors.

categories.heading: Three ways in, not a hundred filters

clothing.name: Clothing
clothing.desc: Cotton and linen that hold their shape long after wash twenty.

toys.name: Toys
toys.desc: Wood and fabric instead of plastic that snaps within a week.

accessories.name: Accessories
accessories.desc: The small things kids wear daily — and don't lose within a month.

about.heading: Why we curate instead of stocking everything
about.body: KidsStore started from a simple frustration: shop shelves full of things built for one season. We work with a small number of makers who show us fabric composition and supply history before anything reaches the catalogue. It's slower than bulk buying — and that's exactly why the range stays small.

trust.heading: What we guarantee, not just promise

materials.title: Materials
materials.desc: Natural fabrics and wood with traceable origin; composition is always listed on the product page.

safety.title: Safety
safety.desc: Every toy is certified to EN71 before it ever reaches the catalogue.

returns.title: Returns
returns.desc: 30 days to return, no questions asked — a piece should suit the kid, not sit in a closet.
